legacyStatement: Fuel products are always the first products in the segment
quote: Fuel products must always be the first products in the segment.
assessment: ATL105 product ordering and Petroleum fleet fuel/maintenance category restrictions constrain different properties; allowed-category restrictions do not establish ordering.

petroleumCounterparts.statement: When the Service Enhancement Indicator is 2, only fuel Product Codes are allowed.

sourceAnchors.quote: The device must interpret the value of the Service Enhancement Indicator
Fuel only if Service Enhancement Indicator = 2. Fuel and maintenance if Service Enhancement Indicator = 1. All products allowed if Service Enhancement Indicator is any other value.

petroleumCounterparts.statement: When the Service Enhancement Indicator is 1, only fuel and maintenance Product Codes are allowed.

sourceAnchors.quote: Fuel only if Service Enhancement Indicator = 2. Fuel and maintenance if Service Enhancement Indicator = 1. All products allowed if Service Enhancement Indicator is any other value.
1 = Fleet (fuel and maintenance only purchases)

petroleumCounterparts.statement: The fuel Restriction Code distinguishes fuel-only from fuel-and-other-products processing; fuel-only transactions contain only fuel Product Codes.

sourceAnchors.quote: the device must interpret the value of the Restriction Code—in the Track 1 or Track 2 data—to see whether the transaction is for “fuel and other products” or “fuel only.”
For EMV transactions, the device must interpret the value of the Restriction Code—from Tag 9F6E Third Part Data —to see whether the transaction is for “fuel and other products” or “fuel only.”

legacyStatement: For EV charging transactions the EV product code is first
quote: For EV charging transactions, the EV fuel product code should be the first product code in the segment.
assessment: The retained Petroleum product rules do not state this EV-specific ordering proposition. This bounded finding does not prove that no EV-related rule exists elsewhere.

legacyStatement: A unique Product Code is sent for each type of fuel purchase
quote: A unique Product Code must be sent for each type of fuel purchase.
assessment: Voyager's fuel-type uniqueness is closely related; Visa's uniqueness covers product codes more broadly. Preserve each source condition and do not infer a Visa all-product extension into ATL105.

petroleumCounterparts.statement: Product codes in one Visa fleet transaction are unique.

sourceAnchors.quote: Note: A unique Product Code must be sent for each type of fuel purchase.

assessment: ATL105 Appendix F assigned-code representation and Petroleum Appendix B membership are different authorities. Shared code identity does not establish description equivalence or transaction permission.

legacyStatement: Multi-fuel OTR transactions list the primary fuel first

assessment: ATL105's OTR primary-fuel ordering is not established by Petroleum fuel/maintenance restriction categories; no ordering equivalence is inferred.

sourceAnchors.quote: The Product Code Data must be sent in all fleet transactions. The sum of all the products in the product segment must equal the total transaction amount.

legacyStatement: The discount amount from Host Discount Data is carried in a subsequent Financial Transaction Request's Product Code Data Segment (102) using Product Code 941 (negative amount, post-pay environment) or 991 (administrative amount, pre-pay environment)
quote: The amount of the discount in a Financial Transaction Request is included in the Product Code Data Segment, Segment No. 102 using Product Code 941 or 991.
assessment: ATL105 Host Discount's codes and pre-pay/post-pay meanings are context-specific; Petroleum Appendix B membership neither supplies nor overrides that behavior.

legacyStatement: Segment 157 does not allow any product codes above '899' except for '955' (Cash Back); if any other code above 899 is present, the transaction will be declined
quote: Note: This segment does not allow any product codes above ‘899’ except for ‘955’ Cash Back. If any of these product codes is present, the transaction will be declined.
assessment: The Segment 157 value cap and 955 exception are separate acceptance conditions from Petroleum's product catalog and fleet restriction categories. Catalog presence does not imply Segment 157 acceptance.
